## Actual experiment

Instead of more body SDF smoothing, isolate whether measured orbital depth and real independent eye meshes improve expressiveness on the recovered native mesh. Source mesh 37,475 vertices, 40,623 triangles, texture converted to vertex colors. Measured dark-orbit vertices near (-.076,.272,.377), (.071,.283,.388). Within projected radius .055 and z>.28, left has 142 vertices and depth quantiles .35755/.37363/.39669; right 67 vertices and .37301/.38985/.42504. This highlights asymmetric sockets, so each eye is positioned independently. Neutralize original painted darkness locally with Gaussian w=.34*exp(-1.8*d), d=sum(((v-center)/(.058,.049,.068))^2); blend RGB111,84,61. Add separate subdivision-4 icosphere ocular surfaces scaled (.047,.041,.037) times scale, with per-eye center shifted in +z by .008 or .021 (scale 1.0 or 1.1). Gaze normalized (.13*sign(x),.035,1); angular iris band .31–.84 rad, dark chocolate radial striation, black pupil, darker limbal ring. Iris color [59+t,38+.65*t,22+.4*t] where t=9*(.5+.5*sin(47*a+2*sin(17*a))), a=atan2(ny,nx). Pupil [12,9,7]; base [34,25,18]; limbal ring .84–1.05 rad [24,18,14]. Export true GLB with separate body/eye geometry and reload both. VTK baseline and both variants rendered offscreen at 0/35/70/110/180 degrees, 400x400, orthographic scale .60. VTK eye material has specular .7 and power64 for diagnostic visualization; this is not verified GLB/browser PBR parity.

## Actual visual gate

Inspected 2000x1200 contact sheet. Real eyes remove the hollow black-socket appearance from frontal view; however both appear too round and bulging in quarter/lateral views, especially forward variant. The facial disc looks rigid and mask-like. Body remains adult-wing-like with scaly surface, greyish body, unnatural feet, and no true soft down. No candidate passes; no phone WebGL test, no release. A geometric eye test is not the finished character. No alteration of main, original concept or production/deployment. Further orbital work should wait for independent juvenile base sculpt rather than repeatedly decorating this rejected source.
